lines.trans: Camille, Gabriel and Sarah are arguing!
What? That is not my problem.
Did you wear that for the audition?
No, I did not go.
Excuse me? You missed the appointment?
There is a screening soon.
It is much better like that.
I worked hard for this role!
Wait, are those my new shoes?
I took them for the photo.
You do not want to work, Sofia!
You do not want to be an actress.
Now, take back your things and get out!
There, I give you back your shoes!

abîmer.gloss: to damage, to ruin, to spoil

meanings.note: abîmer quelque chose = to ruin something

examples.text: Le chien est en train d'abîmer l'argent!
examples.trans: The dog is ruining the money!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: J'ai complètement oublié de prendre des chaussures.
examples.trans: I completely forgot to get shoes.

examples.text: Si je ne peux pas me disputer avec ma mère, avec qui?
examples.trans: If I can't argue with my mother, then who with?

meanings.en: se disputer (avec) = to argue, to quarrel (with)
disputer quelqu'un = to tell someone off

meanings.note: physically hard, or hard to bear
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

meanings.en: to be missed by (tu me manques = I miss you)
meanings.note: back to front: the person missed is the subject

examples.text: Tu as mis ta photo dans cette enveloppe?
examples.trans: Did you put your photo in this envelope?

examples.text: Ce serait mieux avec un homme.
examples.trans: It would be better with a man.

meanings.note: ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

examples.trans: I have nine pages to read.

meanings.note: à neuf heures = at nine o'clock
tag at the end of a question

meanings.en: pardon? = what did you say? / excuse me?
pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.
La projection commence à huit heures.

meanings.note: alone, in surprise or when you didn't hear; a bit blunt

examples.trans: I have an appointment with the doctor.

meanings.note: avoir rendez-vous avec = to have an appointment with

rendre.gloss: to give back, to return; to make (someone happy/sad)

meanings.note: rendre service = to do a favour

reprendre.gloss: to take back; to start again, to pick up

meanings.en: to start again, to resume, to pick up
to take back, to have more of
part, role (in a film or play)

examples.text: Si Kadropov sort avec une belle femme comme toi, il le dit à tout le monde!
examples.trans: If Kadropov goes out with a beautiful woman like you, he tells everyone!

meanings.note: passé composé with 'être': elle est sortie

meanings.en: sortir avec quelqu'un = to go out with someone, to date

meanings.note: before the verb; t' before a vowel
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
travailler à Paris, travailler le dimanche
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age

voilà.gloss: there is; here's; there you go

meanings.note: + noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
il y a = there is / there are
j'y pense = I think about it
